description: Cuts the Dr. Dre beatswitch/bridge from the last version and cuts the song off after the main portion ends. This version of the song was mixed, mastered and intended to release in July 2020. It has a completely new, fully finished Kanye verse as well as a feature from Anderon .Paak. Paak left the session where he recorded his vocals early as he was meant to be a contestant on The Price Is Right, where he won a treadmill. Degraded file leaked after the JESUS IS KING: The Dr. Dre Version July Copy groupbuy.
